answer.answer: The Gram Panchayat (GP) plays a central role in MGNREGA registration [E03]. It verifies that the household is a legitimate entity, that applicants are local residents, and that they are adult members [E03]. The GP must complete verification within a fortnight of receiving the application [E03]. Once a household is found eligible, the GP issues a Job Card within a fortnight, which is handed over to a household member in the presence of other GP residents [E03]. The Panchayat Secretary or Gram Rozgar Sahayak also enters all eligible household particulars into the MIS (NREGASoft) system [E03]. Additionally, registrations are opened throughout the year at the GP office [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: The GP verifies household eligibility including whether the household is a legitimate entity, applicants are local residents, and are adult members
The GP must complete verification within a fortnight of receiving the application
The GP issues a Job Card to eligible households within a fortnight
The Panchayat Secretary or Gram Rozgar Sahayak enters eligible household particulars into the MIS system
Registrations are opened throughout the year at the GP office
